	var optionItems = dropdownElement.querySelectorAll('.user-dropdown-option-item');
	var currentIndex = -1;
	for (var i = 0; i < optionItems.length; i++) {
	if (optionItems[i].classList.contains('is-selected')) { currentIndex = i; break; }
	}
	
	if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
	event.preventDefault();	dropdownElement.classList.toggle('is-open');
	dropdownElement.setAttribute('aria-expanded', dropdownElement.classList.contains('is-open').toString());
	} else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
	event.preventDefault();
	onSelectCallback((currentIndex + 1) % optionItems.length);
	} else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
	event.preventDefault();
	onSelectCallback((currentIndex - 1 + optionItems.length) % optionItems.length);
	} else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
	dropdownElement.classList.remove('is-open');
	dropdownElement.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
	}
	});
	
	var optionItems = dropdownElement.querySelectorAll('.user-dropdown-option-item');
	for (var i = 0; i < optionItems.length; i++) {
	(function (index) {
	optionItems[index].addEventListener('click', function (event) {
	onSelectCallback(index);
	dropdownElement.classList.remove('is-open');
	dropdownElement.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
	event.stopPropagation();
	});
	})(i);
	}}
	
	document.addEventListener('click', closeAllDropdowns);
/* 10. WIRE UP DROPDOWNS */
	initDropdown('dropdown-theme', function (index) {
	activeThemeIndex = index;
	applyTheme(index);
	syncDropdownDisplay('dropdown-theme', 'dropdown-theme-value', themeOptions, index);
	safeSave('usertext_GothPaper', String(index));	});
	
	initDropdown('dropdown-text-alignment', function (index) {
	activeAlignmentIndex = index;
	applyTextAlignment(index);
	syncDropdownDisplay('dropdown-text-alignment', 'dropdown-text-alignment-value', textAlignmentOptions, index);
	safeSave('usertext_AlignMode', String(index));
	if (window.__snapLetterGrid) window.__snapLetterGrid();
	});
/* 11. APPLY INITIAL STATE */
	applyTheme(activeThemeIndex);
	applyTextAlignment(activeAlignmentIndex);
	syncDropdownDisplay(
	'dropdown-theme',
	'dropdown-theme-value',
	themeOptions, activeThemeIndex);
	syncDropdownDisplay(
	'dropdown-text-alignment',
	'dropdown-text-alignment-value',
	textAlignmentOptions, activeAlignmentIndex);
	})();
/* 12. STRUCTURAL MARKERS */
	var markersProcessed = false;

	function processMarkers(container) {
	if (!container || markersProcessed) return;
	markersProcessed = true;

	var html = container.innerHTML;
	var MARKER_RE = /\$(Title|NPC|Time|Message)\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\]/g;

	var newHtml = html.replace(MARKER_RE, function (match, type, value) {
	type = type.toLowerCase();
	value = value.trim();

	if (type === 'message') {
	var incomingIdx = value.indexOf('<');
	var ltLen = 4;
	var isIncoming = incomingIdx >= 0 && incomingIdx < 30;
	if (!isIncoming) {
	var rawLt = value.match(/<(?![a-zA-Z\/!])/);
	if (rawLt) { incomingIdx = rawLt.index; ltLen = 1; isIncoming = incomingIdx < 30; }
	}
	if (!isIncoming) {
	incomingIdx = value.indexOf(':');
	ltLen = 1;
	isIncoming = incomingIdx >= 0 && incomingIdx < 20;
	}
	var outgoingIdx = value.indexOf('>');
	var gtLen = 4;
	var isOutgoing = outgoingIdx >= 0 && outgoingIdx < 30;
	if (!isOutgoing) {
	var rawGt = value.match(/>(?![a-zA-Z\/!])/);
	if (rawGt) { outgoingIdx = rawGt.index; gtLen = 1; isOutgoing = outgoingIdx < 30; }
	}

	var directionClass = isIncoming ? 'incoming' : 'outgoing';
	var bubbleContent = '';
	if (isIncoming) {
	var sender = value.slice(0, incomingIdx).trim();
	var msg = value.slice(incomingIdx + ltLen).trim();
	bubbleContent =
	'<span class="user-marker-message-sender">' + sender + '</span>' +
	'<span class="user-marker-message-text">' + msg + '</span>';
	} else if (isOutgoing) {
	var sender = value.slice(0, outgoingIdx).trim();
	var msg = value.slice(outgoingIdx + gtLen).trim();
	bubbleContent =
	'<span class="user-marker-message-sender">' + sender + '</span>' +
	'<span class="user-marker-message-text">' + msg + '</span>';
	} else {
	bubbleContent = '<span class="user-marker-message-text">' + value + '</span>';
	}
	return '<div class="user-marker-message-wrap ' + directionClass + '" data-message-wrap="true">' +
	'<div class="user-marker-message-bubble">' + bubbleContent + '</div></div>';
	} else {
	return '<span class="user-marker-' + type + '">' + value + '</span>';
	}
	});

	/* FIX: write newHtml cleanly — never reassign from old innerHTML */
	if (newHtml !== html) {
	newHtml = newHtml.replace(
	/<\/div>\s*(?:<br\s*\/?>\s*)*<div class="user-marker-message-wrap/gi,
	'</div><div class="user-marker-message-wrap'
	);
	container.innerHTML = newHtml;
	}

	/* Snap message bubbles to line grid */
	setTimeout(function () {
	var lineHeight = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(container).lineHeight);
	var wraps = container.querySelectorAll('[data-message-wrap]');
	wraps.forEach(function (wrap) {
	var bubble = wrap.querySelector('.user-marker-message-bubble');
	if (bubble && lineHeight) {
	var linesNeeded = Math.ceil(bubble.offsetHeight / lineHeight);
	wrap.style.height = (linesNeeded * lineHeight) + 'px';
	}
	});
	}, 100);
	}
/* 13. DETAILS SNAP TO GRID — fixed for nested details */
	function snapDetailsToGrid(container) {
	if (!container) return;

	function snapOne(details) {
	if (!details.open) {
	var summary = details.querySelector(':scope > summary');
	/* Closed: lock height to summary so nested content is hidden */
	details.style.height = summary ? summary.offsetHeight + 'px' : '';
	details.style.overflow = 'hidden';
	return;
	}
	/* Open: let content flow naturally — no fixed height */
	details.style.height = '';
	details.style.overflow = '';
	}

	function snapAll() {
	/* Snap deepest-nested <details> first so parent measurements
	   reflect already-settled child heights */
	var allDetails = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('details'));
	allDetails.sort(function (a, b) {
	function depth(el) {
	var d = 0, cur = el.parentElement;
	while (cur && cur !== container) { if (cur.tagName === 'DETAILS') d++; cur = cur.parentElement; }
	return d;
	}
	return depth(b) - depth(a); /* deeper first */
	});
	allDetails.forEach(snapOne);
	}

	/* Wire toggle listener to every <details>, including nested ones.
	   After snapping heights, also redraw rule lines so blocked ranges update. */
	container.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(function (details) {
	details.addEventListener('toggle', function () {
	requestAnimationFrame(function () {
	snapAll();
	/* Give the DOM one more frame to settle before redrawing lines */
	requestAnimationFrame(function () {
	drawRuleLines(container);
	});
	});
	});
	});

	snapAll(); /* initial pass */
	}

/* 14. DRAW RULE LINES */
	var ruleOverlay = null;

	function getContainerLines(root) {
	var range = document.createRange();
	var EXCLUDE = 'details, summary, pre, code, [data-message-wrap], [data-rule-overlay]';
	var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
	acceptNode: function (node) {
	if (node.parentElement && node.parentElement.closest(EXCLUDE))
	return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
	return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
	}
	});
	var lineMap = [];
	var TOLERANCE = 2;
	var node;
	while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
	if (!node.textContent || !node.textContent.replace(/[\s\n\r]+/g, '')) continue;
	range.selectNodeContents(node);
	var rects = range.getClientRects();
	for (var i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
	var r = rects[i];
	if (r.height === 0) continue;
	var merged = false;
	for (var j = 0; j < lineMap.length; j++) {
	if (Math.abs(lineMap[j].top - r.top) <= TOLERANCE) {
	lineMap[j].bottom = Math.max(lineMap[j].bottom, r.bottom);
	merged = true; break;
	}
	}
	if (!merged) lineMap.push({ top: r.top, bottom: r.bottom });
	}
	}
	lineMap.sort(function (a, b) { return a.top - b.top; });
	return lineMap;
	}

	function drawRuleLines(container) {
	if (!container) return;

	/* Remove old overlay BEFORE measuring — prevents stale rects skewing layout */
	if (ruleOverlay) { ruleOverlay.remove(); ruleOverlay = null; }
	void container.offsetHeight; /* force reflow */

	var containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
	var lines = getContainerLines(container);

	/* Collect bounding boxes of elements that should have NO rule lines
	   drawn over them (details blocks, pre blocks) */
	var BLOCK_SELECTOR = 'details, pre';
	var blockedRanges = [];
	container.querySelectorAll(BLOCK_SELECTOR).forEach(function (el) {
	/* Only block top-level matches — nested ones are already covered by parent */
	if (el.parentElement && el.parentElement.closest(BLOCK_SELECTOR)) return;
	var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
	if (r.height === 0) return;
	blockedRanges.push({
	top: r.top - containerRect.top + container.scrollTop,
	bottom: r.bottom - containerRect.top + container.scrollTop
	});
	});

	function isBlocked(lineTop) {
	for (var i = 0; i < blockedRanges.length; i++) {
	if (lineTop >= blockedRanges[i].top - 2 && lineTop <= blockedRanges[i].bottom + 2) return true;
	}
	return false;
	}

	ruleOverlay = document.createElement('div');
	ruleOverlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
	ruleOverlay.setAttribute('data-rule-overlay', 'true');
	ruleOverlay.style.cssText =
	'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;right:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;height:' +
	container.clientHeight + 'px';

	var ruleColor = getComputedStyle(container).getPropertyValue('--user-color-rule-line').trim() || 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
	var ruleWidth = getComputedStyle(container).getPropertyValue('--user-border-width-thin').trim() || '1px';
	var containerHeight = container.clientHeight;

	lines.forEach(function (line) {
	var top = line.bottom - containerRect.top + container.scrollTop;
	if (top < 0 || top > containerHeight) return;
	/* Skip lines that fall inside a details/pre block */
	if (isBlocked(top)) return;
	var lineEl = document.createElement('div');
	lineEl.style.cssText =
	'position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:' + top + 'px;height:' + ruleWidth + ';background:' + ruleColor;
	ruleOverlay.appendChild(lineEl);
	});

	/* Append at END — never insertBefore(firstChild) which shifts layout */
	container.appendChild(ruleOverlay);
	}

	function scheduleGridSnap(container) {
	requestAnimationFrame(function () {
	requestAnimationFrame(function () {
	drawRuleLines(container);
	});
	});
	}

/* 15. INIT */
	setTimeout(function () {
	var container = document.getElementById('letter-text-content');
	if (!container) return;

	processMarkers(container);
	snapDetailsToGrid(container);

	if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
	document.fonts.ready.then(function () { scheduleGridSnap(container); });
	} else {
	scheduleGridSnap(container);
	}

	var resizeTimer;
	new ResizeObserver(function () {
	clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
	resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { scheduleGridSnap(container); }, 100);
	}).observe(container);

	window.__snapLetterGrid = function () { scheduleGridSnap(container); };
	}, 0);
</script>
